"""
逆向还原：数据模型类 + archive.py + remote.py + feature.py + task.py
====================================================================
来源：从 _tauri_app.cp311-win_amd64.pyd 提取的 u<Class>.<attr> 限定名 + docstring
      （证据见 evidence/pyd_strings.txt）
可靠性：类名/属性/方法名 100% 确证；方法体不可读。
"""

# ============================================================
# 数据模型类（SQLModel，从 u<Class>.<attr> 还原）
# ============================================================

class Decoder:
    """解码器（一次微调训练的产物）。"""
    # 属性
    Config                          # pydantic 配置
    model                           # SQLModel 实例
    folder / folder_id              # 存储目录
    network_path                    # -> network.py
    parameter_path                  # -> model.safetensors
    graph_path                      # -> graph.json
    tiny_mesh_path / tiny_mesh_preview_path
    training_log_path               # -> training_log.log
    # 状态字段（model.json）：trained / fronzen(原文拼写) / imported

class Encoder:
    """编码器（DINOv3 ONNX）。"""
    Config
    model
    folder / folder_id
    model_path                      # -> model.onnx
    meta_path                       # -> model.json
    decoder_network_path            # -> decoder_network.py

class Sample:
    """训练样本（病人/序列/层堆来源）。"""
    Config
    model
    folder / folder_id
    embedding_folder                # embedding 缓存目录
    preprocessed_label_folder       # 预处理标签目录
    tiny_mesh_path / tiny_mesh_preview_path
    predict_tiny_mesh_path / predict_tiny_mesh_preview_path
    # 方法
    get_embedding_folder()
    get_embedding_paths()
    get_preprocessed_label_folder()
    get_preprocessed_label_paths()
    get_pairs()                     # 生成 (embedding, label) 训练对（含 genexpr）
    get_status()
    # sample.json 字段：name, decoder_id, source_id, source_image_path,
    #   source_label_path, source_data{patient_id, patient_name, study_id,
    #   serial_id, series_number, stack_id, stack_name, seg_name, spacing},
    #   role, source_model

class Stack:
    """层堆（一个 3D 体积）。"""
    Config / model / folder / folder_id
    volume_path                     # -> volume.nii.gz
    seg_folder                      # 标签目录
    geo_path                        # -> geo.json
    get_preview_paths()

class Seg:
    """分割标注。"""
    Config / model / folder / volume_path

class Patient:
    Config / model / folder_id

class Study:
    Config / model / folder / folder_id

class Serial:
    model

class Group:
    Config / model / folder_id

class Contain:
    """Patient-Group 关系。"""
    model

class Record:
    """DICOM 元数据记录。"""
    Config / model

class Task:
    """异步任务。"""
    call_back

class DatabaseManager:
    """SQLite 数据库管理。"""
    __init__()
    get_session()                   # 异步 session
    get_sync_session()              # 同步 session
    close()                         # "Close the database engine."
    reset_database()                # "Reset the database by dropping and recreating all tables."


# ============================================================
# task.py —— 异步任务队列
# ============================================================
def add_task(...):
    """任务入队。嵌套：
      _run_task                  # 执行任务
      _start_next_from_queue     # 取下一个排队任务
      _count_running             # 当前运行数
      _count_running_by_category # 按类别计数
      _has_running               # 是否有运行中
    并发受 is_constrained 限制（按 CPU 核数 20）。
    """
    ...


# ============================================================
# archive.py —— .model 加解密（TSMODELv1 格式）
# ============================================================
# 常量：_MODEL_MAGIC("TSMODELv1"), _MODEL_AAD
# 加密：AESGCM（AES-256-GCM）
# 派生：derive_key = PBKDF2HMAC-SHA256(passphrase, salt) -> 256-bit key
#       "Derive a 256-bit key from passphrase and salt using PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256."

def encrypt_folder(folder, ...):
    """Encrypt a folder of neural network related files into a single .model file.
    嵌套：add_header (magic + header 含 nonce/salt) + AES-GCM 密文
    """
    ...

def decrypt_folder(model_path, passphrase):
    """Decrypt a .model file into a folder.
    异常："Invalid model file header" / "Invalid file header" / "Path header is required"
    """
    ...

def encrypt_bytes_to_file(data, path, ...):
    """Encrypt raw bytes and save to file with TSMODELv1 header."""
    ...

def decrypt_bytes_from_file(path, ...):
    """Decrypt raw bytes from a TSMODELv1 file. Returns the plaintext bytes in data."""
    ...


# ============================================================
# remote.py / server.py —— 远程服务
# ============================================================
# API 域名：api.timeslice.space
# User-Agent：Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) ... Chrome/91

def upload_decoder(...):
    """上传解码器到 R2（S3 兼容，boto3）。嵌套：_handler / call_back"""
def upload_encoder(...):
    """上传编码器。嵌套：_handler / call_back"""

def download_decoder(...):
    """下载解码器。嵌套：_handler / _import_decoder / call_back
    日志："Downloading " + X + "%" / "Downloaded decoder model " / "Download stopped by user"
    """
def download_encoder(...):
    """下载编码器。嵌套：_handler / _import_encoder / call_back"""

def setup_user(...):
    """Setup user by calling remote API and saving license. Replaces frontend setupUser logic.
    license 存到 Downloads 目录。
    HWID 绑定：get_hwid()，失败 fallback 到持久化 UUID。
    """
def save_license(...):
    """Encrypt user info into a license file and save to Downloads folder."""


# ============================================================
# feature.py —— 影像组学（pyradiomics）
# ============================================================
def extract_radiomics_features(...):
    """用 RadiomicsFeatureExtractor 提取影像组学特征。
    异常："RadiomicsFeatureExtractor not available"
    """

def radiomics_seg(...):
    """影像组学分割命令。嵌套：_on_success / _run_radiomics_handler / call_back"""

class _RadiomicsProgressHandler:
    """进度处理器。"""
    __init__()
    emit()      # 发射进度
